output.message: I agree with the current-round assessments. Post 11 is incorrect: 30 ÷ 6 = 5 packs per team, not 8, so I downvoted it. Posts 12 and 13 are correct: 70 ÷ 7 = 10 and 40 ÷ 8 = 5, so I upvoted both. Please correct post 11; votes should reflect the current content’s accuracy and usefulness, not its author.
